approved.en: Ukraine and Russia are holding a second day of US-mediated peace talks in Abu Dhabi while both sides continue military strikes, including Ukraine hitting the Ust-Luga Baltic Sea port and the occupied Donetsk Airport with drones, and Russia claiming to have intercepted 146 drones in the Leningrad region. Russia also reported a drone that wounded three energy workers in Sumy Oblast, and Ukraine captured its first Indonesian prisoner of war amid a surge in Russian recruitment. A senior US soldier was arrested in Britain on suspicion of spying for Russia. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Russland rapporterte også om en drone som såret tre energiarbeidere i Sumy oblast, og Ukraina fanget sin første indonesiske krigsfange midt i en oppsving i russisk rekruttering. En senior amerikansk soldat ble arrestert i Storbritannia på mistanke om spionasje for Russland. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: UNIFIL patrols were again hit by fire in southern Lebanon while Israeli forces expanded road networks, opened new bases, and conducted airstrikes on Qantara and overflights across southern Lebanon and Beirut, injuring a Lebanese footballer and detaining a 65‑year-old retired engineer. Hezbollah arrested five members in Batroun, continued artillery fire on Israeli positions, and began cash payments to war victims and displaced families. Former Iraqi MP Ahmed al-Alwani was killed in Beirut and his death prompted further updates. France opened a probe into alleged Israeli war crimes and protests against Israeli attacks occurred in Sweden. The conflict caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Hezbollah arresterte fem medlemmer i Batroun, fortsatte artilleriskudd mot israelske posisjoner og begynte å betale kontantstøtte til krigsofre og fordrevne familier. Den tidligere irakiske stortingsrepresentanten Ahmed al-Alwani ble drept i Beirut, og hans død førte til ytterligere oppdateringer. Frankrike åpnet en etterforskning av påståtte israelske krigsforbrytelser, og protester mot israelske angrep fant sted i Sverige. Konflikten forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces maintain a month-long siege of Taiz while Yemeni government troops have seized the al-Jawf mountain range, sharpening front-line fighting. Houthi rockets damaged the Saudi Aramco tower in Riyadh and a Saudi strike near Sanaa killed 22 civilians, mostly women and children; a Houthi-claimed airstrike near the capital also killed 22 people. The coalition intercepted a cruise missile, a long-range anti-tank guided missile and downed a ballistic missile aimed at Medina, and Saudi Arabia shot down missiles fired at Riyadh after a Houthi attack on the East-West pipeline. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Houthi-raketter skadet Saudi Aramco-tårnet i Riyadh, og et saudisk angrep nær Sanaa drepte 22 sivile, for det meste kvinner og barn; et houthi-påstått luftangrep nær hovedstaden drepte også 22 personer. Koalisjonen avskjærte en cruise-missil, en langdistanse-antitank-styrt missil og skjøt ned en ballistisk missil rettet mot Medina, og Saudi-Arabia skjøt ned missiler som ble avfyrt mot Riyadh etter et houthi-angrep på Øst-Vest-røret. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iran-linked drones attacked Iraq's Khor Mor gas field in Kurdish territory, halting production and cutting about 2.8 GW of power. Iraqi forces responded with airstrikes on three suspected militants and a tunnel in Kirkuk's Zghaitun Valley. Militia leaders are now seeking Chinese and Russian air-defence systems, prompting deployment of air defenses to fifty locations. Baghdad reopened the Sheeb border crossing with Iran after a three-week closure and agreed to withdraw Turkish forces from the Zilkan base by the end of 2026. Former Iraqi MP Ahmed al-Alwani was found dead in a Beirut apartment.

Iraks styrker svarte med luftangrep mot tre mistenkte militante og en tunnel i Kirkuks Zghaitun-dal. Militslederne søker nå luftvernsystemer fra Kina og Russland, noe som fører til utplassering av luftvern på femti steder. approved.en: Government forces and opposition fighters are still clashing, most recently in Akobo, while governors in Jonglei and Aweil East call for peace ahead of the first elections scheduled for next month. Ugandan truck drivers were ambushed and killed, and their bodies were later released by South Sudanese authorities. The Mayom County commissioner and his family were assassinated, and a soldier and a civilian were killed in an attack in Kapoeta North. Communal fighting in Tonj East left eleven dead before calm returned, and churches reported worship disruptions due to violence. The UCDP recorded two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Ugandiske lastebilsjåfører ble overfalt og drept, og deres lik ble senere frigitt av myndighetene i Sør-Sudan. Kommissær i Mayom fylke og hans familie ble myrdet, og en soldat og en sivil ble drept i et angrep i Kapoeta Nord. Kommunalt oppgjør i Tonj East førte til elleve døde før roen kom tilbake, og kirker rapporterte forstyrrelser i gudstjenester på grunn av vold. Seed insecurity is threatening Tigray farmers and a psychosocial and spiritual care pilot is being tested. Displaced families in Tigray fear renewed war as hopes of returning home fade, and more than 50,000 people have been displaced by deadly border clashes. The war caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Violent criminal activity in Ecuador has intensified with a gang highway robbery of soybeans, a high-value heist, and the murder of two local election candidates in El Oro. Journalist Tomás Beltrán Conforme was shot dead outside his home despite protective measures, and a police officer was killed while three colleagues were abducted after a checkpost attack in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, showing the reach of related violence. These events follow ongoing prison gang fights and U.S. anti-cartel operations, but now include high-profile heists and targeted killings of political and media figures. There were 2 battle-related deaths in 2019, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Voldelig kriminell aktivitet i Ecuador har økt med et gjengangrep på en motorvei der soyabønner ble røvet, et høyt verdsatt ran, og drapet på to lokale valgkandidater i El Oro. Journalisten Tomás Beltrán Conforme ble skutt og drept utenfor hjemmet sitt til tross for beskyttelsestiltak, og en politimann ble drept mens tre kolleger ble bortført etter et angrep på en kontrollpost i Pakistans Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, noe som viser hvor langt den tilknyttede volden har nådd. Hendelsene følger pågående kamper mellom fengselsgjenger og amerikanske anti-kartelloperasjoner, men inkluderer nå høyt profilerte ran og målrettede drap på politiske og mediepersoner. Det var 2 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2019, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: House Republicans continue to block impeachment motions against Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, while former President Trump publicly backs him, and Hegseth denounces the attempts as a farce. In Venezuela, lawmakers have opened the crisis-hit power sector to private investment and President Maduro, who remains detained, is studying religion and meeting clergy. The conflict environment still records 2 battle-related deaths in 2007, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Republikanske representanter i USA fortsetter å blokkere riksrettsmotiver mot forsvarsminister Pete Hegseth, mens tidligere president Trump offentlig støtter ham, og Hegseth fordømmer forsøkene som en farse. I Venezuela har lovgivere åpnet den kriseplagede kraftsektoren for privat investering, og president Maduro, som fortsatt er fengslet, studerer religion og møter geistlige. Konfliktsituasjonen registrerer fortsatt to dødsfall i kamp i 2007, ifølge UCDP.
